original_ai_output.title_zh: 卡杜纳州立大学ASUU暂停罢工
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚卡杜纳州立大学（KASU）的大学学术人员工会（ASUU）在卡杜纳州政府批准落实2025年联邦政府与ASUU协议后，于2026年9月17日（周四）的代表大会上一致同意暂停正在进行的罢工。州政府表示将把给予KASU学术人员的薪资相关让步扩展至其他州立高等院校，并已成立九人高等教育机构谈判委员会。相关消息目前为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Kaduna State University (KASU), Zaria, Kaduna State

key_facts.fact: 卡杜纳州立大学ASUU在州政府批准落实2025年联邦政府-ASUU协议后暂停罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU), Kaduna State University (KASU) chapter, has suspended its ongoing strike following the Kaduna State Government's approval of the implementation and domestication of the 2025 Federal Government-ASUU agreement for academic staff.

key_facts.fact: 工会于2026年9月17日周四代表大会后宣布暂停罢工，成员一致接受
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The union announced the suspension after its congress meeting on Thursday, September 17, 2026, where members unanimously accepted

key_facts.fact: 州政府称将把给予KASU学术人员的薪资相关让步扩展至其他州立高等院校
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Kaduna State Government has said it will extend the salary-related concessions recently granted to academic staff of Kaduna State University (KASU) to other state-owned tertiary institutions.

key_facts.fact: 州长已成立九人高等教育机构谈判委员会与工会协商
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said the governor had constituted a nine-member tertiary institutions negotiation committee to engage the unions towards amicable solution.

key_facts.fact: KASU协议的实施预计从10月薪资开始
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to him, the implementation of the KASU agreement is expected to commence with the October salary

uncertainties: 该事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
与其他院校工会的谈判结果及适用安排尚未确定
